summary.name: TaskPaper
summary.one_liner: TaskPaper is a Mac to-do list and outlining app that stores lists as plain text files.
use_cases: managing personal to-do lists on a Mac
organizing projects with nested tasks and notes
keeping task lists as editable plain text files
filtering large lists by tag or content
importing and exporting tasks with Reminders
scripting or theming a plain text task manager
summary.what_it_does: TaskPaper is a plain text to-do list app for Mac that feels like a text editor but is backed by an outliner. Lists are stored as plain text files that can be edited anywhere, and typed lines are auto formatted into projects, tasks, notes, and @tags. Users can fold, focus, and filter lists by @tag, type, or content, and navigate with keyboard shortcuts. The app supports drag and drop reordering, managing dates and times in plain text, and import/export with Reminders.app. Theming uses LESS/CSS stylesheets, and an extensive JavaScript API is available for scripting.
notable: Plain text files with auto-formatted projects, tasks, notes and @tags
Outliner with folding, focus and filtering for large lists
LESS/CSS theming and JavaScript API for scripting
Source code available to license holders
